title: Montana requires quarterly customer-premises-equipment shipment counts to project locations
summary: The LEO quarterly schema requires the number of customer premises equipment units shipped to project broadband serviceable locations during the reporting period. Denominator: The approved project BSL cohort and quarter, separating CPE shipped from delivered, installed, activated, subscribed, tested, retained, or accepted.
